user_problem: Document headings may promise topics, scope or conclusions that their sections do not actually cover.
unique_output: A heading-by-heading coverage table showing the heading promise, supporting section content, missing elements, overbroad wording and bounded repair options.
required_input: A complete document with stable heading or section IDs, the intended hierarchy, and any protected headings or required topics.
critical_rule: Assess coverage from the supplied section content rather than the heading alone; never invent missing content or silently alter protected headings.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is content-refresh-plan; this audits heading-to-section alignment in a supplied document rather than planning evidence-driven updates.
acceptance_scenario: Input heading 'Costs and limitations' introduces a section that discusses fees but no limitations. Output marks costs covered, limitations absent, and offers either narrowing the heading or adding supported limitation content.
